s: A company wants to migrate its workloads from on premises to AWS. The workloads run on Linux and Windows. The company has a large on-premises intra structure that consists of physical machines and VMs that host numerous applications. The company must capture details about the system configuration. system performance. running processure and network coi.net lions of its o. -premises ,on boards. The company also must divide the on-premises applications into groups for AWS migrations. The company needs recommendations for Amazon EC2 instance types so that the company can run its workloads on AWS in the most costeffective manner. Which combination of steps should a solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Select THREE.)
o: Assess the existing applications by installing AWS Application Discovery Agent on the physical machines and VMs.
Assess the existing applications by installing AWS Systems Manager Agent on the physical machines and VMs
Group servers into applications for migration by using AWS Systems Manager Application Manager.
Group servers into applications for migration by using AWS Migration Hub.
Generate recommended instance types and associated costs by using AWS Migration Hub.
Import data about server sizes into AWS Trusted Advisor. Follow the recommendations for cost optimization.

w.y: The data needed (system configuration, performance, running processes, network connections) is exactly what the Application Discovery Agent collects from physical servers and VMs. Migration Hub then groups the discovered servers into applications and generates EC2 instance-type recommendations with estimated costs.

o.A: Correct: the Discovery Agent captures configuration, performance, processes and network connections on physical and virtual hosts.
o.B: SSM Agent manages nodes but does not collect discovery data such as network dependencies for migration.
o.C: Systems Manager Application Manager organizes AWS resources, not on-premises servers for migration waves.
o.D: Correct: Migration Hub groups discovered servers into applications for migration tracking.
o.E: Correct: Migration Hub generates EC2 instance recommendations and cost estimates from discovery data.
o.F: Trusted Advisor checks existing AWS resources and cannot import on-premises server data.
